item.name: Huddlestock Fintech AS
item.description: Norwegian listed company, based in Stavanger. On 26 November 2026 it entered into a partnership agreement with Firi AS for a tied-agent solution under its MiFID II framework, with a fixed monthly fee plus a volume-based fee, subject to customary regulatory notifications, according to its MFN notice. The agreement follows a letter of intent announced on 18 November 2026.

sources.title: Huddlestock has signed a letter of intent (LOI) with Firi
Huddlestock Fintech AS has entered into a partnership agreement with Firi AS, the largest cryptocurrency exchange in the Nordics
